Card Q&A.a: No. This effect can't be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from your trash to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's effect be used to return a level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] inherited effect from my trash to my hand?

Effect: [On Deletion] You may return 1 level 3 Digimon card with an [On Deletion] effect other than [Fake Agumon Expert] from your trash to your hand.
